title: File:겨자만.jpg
creator: Hj03064
notes: Yellow hot-mustard paste (Korean gyeoja, visually the same as Japanese neri-karashi) swirled in a small white square dish. Plain white/light-grey background, no watermark or text. Unbranded.

title: File:Wasabi 002.jpg
creator: publicdomainq.net (https://publicdomainq.net/wasabi-japanese-horseradish-0000353/)
notes: Freshly grated wasabi on a small dark ceramic dish, with a whole wasabi rhizome blurred behind it. Plain white background, no watermark. Alternative: 'File:Wasabi paste.jpg' (Tiia Monto, CC BY-SA 4.0, 1099x1085) shows paste alone on white with no container.

title: File:Opened garlic bulb with garlic clove.jpg
creator: Dubravko Sorić SoraZG on Flickr
notes: FALLBACK: a whole raw garlic bulb (partly opened) plus one peeled clove. Not grated or paste. Pure white studio background, no watermark. No grated/paste-form candidate passed: they all had busy kitchen/table backgrounds, branded jars with text overlays, or collages. The closest was rawpixel 'Free minced garlic image' (CC0), but it shows a garlic press, peels and a bulb on a veined marble surface, so it was rejected.

title: File:Ginger rhizome.jpg
creator: Mk2010
notes: FALLBACK: whole raw ginger rhizomes, not grated. Plain light-grey/white surface, no watermark. No grated-ginger candidate passed: they had busy backgrounds (red tablecloth, wooden table, hands, cutting board with knife) or showed branded ginger-garlic jars on a store shelf or with text overlays. 'Ginger Root (179871501)' on black was rejected because of a photographer signature in the corner.

title: Sesame seeds
creator: Simoubuntu
notes: White sesame seeds spilled on a plain white surface, next to a small unbranded steel spice tin with a window lid. Seamless white-to-grey gradient backdrop, no watermark. The largest size Openverse offers is 1024 px. Alternative: 'File:Sesame-Seeds.jpg' (Commons, public domain, 948x735), a pile of seeds on a black plate.
